name: Amalfi Coast
about: Jun–Aug is beautiful but packed and expensive on narrow coastal roads. Apr–May and Sep–Oct are the local favorite.
overview: Cliffside towns stacked above the Tyrrhenian Sea, connected by winding coastal roads, ferries, and some of Italy's best seafood.
costOverview: An espresso at the bar costs almost nothing, but dining with a view or a day at a beach club runs high.
monthlyWeather: cold and quiet, with many hotels and restaurants closed for the season
